extracted.intended_audience: general newspaper readers and policymakers interested in postwar Europe and Middle East affairs
extracted.subtask_description: News reporting on post‑World War II political, economic and security arrangements (Germany reparations/administration, Palestine mandate withdrawal, labor unrest in France/Italy, and war‑crimes trials). Summarizes proposals, deadlines, authorities and demands affecting governance and reconstruction.

rubrics_metrics.name: Economic rehabilitation constrained by security
rubrics_metrics.description: These objectives shall be pursued with due regard to the interests of security and to preventing the restoration of Germany’s war industry.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Economic rehabilitation of countries affected by German aggression must be balanced against measures to insure security and to prevent reestablishment of military industry in Germany.

rubrics_metrics.name: Establishment of central German administrative departments
rubrics_metrics.description: The Control Council is directed to set up at the earliest possible moment central German administrative departments dealing with matters calling for centralized decisions in spheres indicated in the Potsdam Agreement, as well as for food and agriculture.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Central departments should be created quickly to handle nationwide matters identified by Potsdam and essential sectors like food and agriculture.

rubrics_metrics.name: Allied supervision and zone commander authority over German departments
rubrics_metrics.description: Central German administrative departments will be under the supervision and direction of the appropriate quadripartite agencies of the Allied Control Authority... The zone commanders, each in his own zone, shall exercise general supervision and control over the activities of central German departments... In cases where the directives of the central German administration contravene the directives of the Control Council the zone commanders shall, after informing the Control Council, have the right to suspend the execution of such directives, and the Control Council will make the final decision.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: German central administrations operate under allied quadripartite oversight; zone commanders have supervisory power in their zones and may suspend conflicting German directives pending Control Council decision.

rubrics_metrics.name: Rehabilitation depends primarily on German people's efforts
rubrics_metrics.description: The raising of the level in the matter of the economic rehabilitation of Germany depends primarily on the efforts of the German people themselves.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: While external measures are provided, success of economic recovery is stated to rely chiefly on internal German effort and initiative.

rubrics_metrics.name: Central departments to frame rehabilitation within new industrial limits and reparations obligations
rubrics_metrics.description: Central German departments shall be responsible for framing measures for the rehabilitation of the German economy within the limits of the new level of industry, Germany being bound to fulfill unconditionally the reparation and other basic obligations imposed upon her.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Rehabilitation planning must respect imposed industrial limits and the unconditional fulfilment of reparations and other obligations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Interzonal economic integration and abolition of zonal agencies
rubrics_metrics.description: When central German departments have been set up and the procedure for the fulfillment of other main obligations has been decided, interzonal economic barriers shall be abolished... All zonal German economic agencies covering one or more zones shall also be abolished.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Restore nationwide economic coordination by removing interzonal barriers and eliminating zone‑specific economic agencies once central structures exist.

rubrics_metrics.name: Joint control of the Ruhr region
rubrics_metrics.description: Because the industry of the Ruhr region was the main basis of German militarism, the Ruhr industrial region shall be placed under the joint control of the United Kingdom, France, the United States of America and the U.S.S.R.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Place strategic industrial areas (Ruhr) under four‑power joint control to prevent remilitarization.

rubrics_metrics.name: Nationwide reform of financial and monetary system
rubrics_metrics.description: Action on a nation-wide scale shall be taken to reform the financial and monetary system in Germany.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A comprehensive, Germany‑wide monetary and financial reform is required as part of economic rehabilitation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Encourage expansion of German exports to secure imports and meet obligations
rubrics_metrics.description: In order to insure imports of raw materials and other materials necessary for German peacetime industry and the discharge by Germany of her obligations to the Allies, the expansion of German exports shall be encouraged.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Promote exports to obtain needed imports and enable Germany to meet reparations and other obligations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Void agreements contravening Germany's economic unity
rubrics_metrics.description: The agreement concerning the economic unification of the British and American zones as well as separate agreements connected with this unification shall be deemed null and void as contravening the economic unity of Germany.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Treat any arrangements that undermine overall economic unity as invalid; prioritize a single economic space for Germany.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fix total volume and allocations of reparations (including USSR share)
rubrics_metrics.description: To fix the total volume of reparations from Germany at... To fix reparations for the U.S.S.R. at $10,000,000,000, the Soviet Union to satisfy the reparation claims of Poland from its share.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Set total reparations and allocate shares (example: USSR $10 billion with Poland claims to be satisfied from USSR share).

rubrics_metrics.name: Permitted sources for reparations
rubrics_metrics.description: To utilize for the coverage of reparations: (A) Once-for-all removals which were or will be made... (B) Annual deliveries of goods (C) German assets abroad (D) Various services.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reparations may be satisfied by equipment removals, annual goods deliveries, seized assets abroad, and services—each category enumerated as acceptable sources.

rubrics_metrics.name: Deadline to complete Potsdam removal decisions
rubrics_metrics.description: Potsdam decisions shall be completed by the end of 1948.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Set a firm timetable for implementation of removal/transfer measures arising from Potsdam decisions (end‑1948).

rubrics_metrics.name: Reparations fulfillment period (twenty years)
rubrics_metrics.description: To determine that the reparation obligations of Germany... be of twenty years, this period to be... (text indicates a 20‑year period).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Establish a long‑term (about 20‑year) time frame for fulfilling reparations obligations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Renew Inter‑Allied Committee for Reparations
rubrics_metrics.description: To renew the activity of the Inter-Allied Committee for Reparations, consisting of representatives of Britain, the U.S.A., France and Russia.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reconstitute a multilateral committee to coordinate reparations policy and implementation among the four powers.

rubrics_metrics.name: British plan to terminate Palestine mandate and timetable
rubrics_metrics.description: Britain has recommended to the United Nations that she terminate her 26‑year mandate May 15... formal inauguration of the Arab-Jewish states June 1—after a two-week transition period... Britain's final deadline for evacuation of her troops will remain August 1.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Set specific withdrawal and transition dates (May 15 mandate termination; two‑week transition; June 1 inauguration; August 1 final troop withdrawal), subject to U.N. approval.

rubrics_metrics.name: Creation and authorization of Arab and Jewish civil guards during withdrawal
rubrics_metrics.description: British authorities in Palestine are authorizing creation of Arab and Jewish civil guard organizations now to maintain law and order at key spots... Creation of a Jewish guard did not automatically imply British recognition of Hagana, but the civic guard would likely be based on the Haganah organization.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Permit local civil guard formations to maintain order during withdrawal; clarify that authorization does not equal formal recognition of existing paramilitary groups.

rubrics_metrics.name: British security responsibility limited to troop‑occupied areas until withdrawal
rubrics_metrics.description: From May 15 until final withdrawal of troops set for August 1, Britain will be responsible for security only in her troop‑occupied area around Haifa... British plan for handing over power was subject to approval of the United Nations commission of five nations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Limit occupier responsibility geographically and temporally; require international commission approval for final arrangements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Immigration adjustment before mandate end
rubrics_metrics.description: Between now and May 15 Britain probably will transfer to Palestine 116,000 uncertified Jewish emigrants held in Cyprus, thus dispensing with the present 1,500 monthly Jewish immigration quota.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Temporary measures to increase admission of detained immigrants prior to mandate termination, suspending prior quotas.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of Trans‑Jordan Arab Legion for policing strategic areas
rubrics_metrics.description: Britain was still negotiating with the Trans‑Jordan Government to obtain units of the Arab Legion to police strategically‑important parts of Arab Palestine, including pipeline and installation areas.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consider employing neighboring state forces to police strategic infrastructure during transition; negotiate terms with local governments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Government strike‑control measures and ultimatum in France
rubrics_metrics.description: The Government handed an ultimatum to the Communist‑led General Confederation of Labor demanding that French workers return to their jobs by Wednesday, and quickly backed up its order with a strong show of force... The Government began using its powers under the new strike control law against strike inciters, saboteurs and persons preventing nonstrikers from working.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Authorities may issue ultimatums, deploy troops, and invoke special strike‑control laws to compel return to work; enforcement targets include incitement, sabotage and obstruction.

rubrics_metrics.name: Penalties, arrests and prosecutions for strike‑related offenses
rubrics_metrics.description: Eighteen men were arrested at Montpellier under the law and were charged with obstructing workers at an automobile plant... The Government said it would not attempt to prosecute strikers except those guilty of sabotage, violence, preventing non‑strikers from working or otherwise violating the strike control law.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Apply arrests, charges and prosecutions selectively to those committing violent or obstructive acts during industrial actions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Government economic offers to end strikes
rubrics_metrics.description: The Government said it would begin immediately studies to stabilize wages and prices in order to fix a minimum salary effective December 1... offered a cost‑of‑living premium and other terms to induce workers to return.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Combine enforcement with economic concessions (cost‑of‑living premiums, minimum salary, consultations on wage scales) to restore industrial peace.

rubrics_metrics.name: Union demands in Italy following demonstrator's death
rubrics_metrics.description: The Joint Union Council demanded: 1) Make public the results of the investigation and punish the 'guilty' police. 2) Appropriate the equivalent of $16,667,000 immediately for make‑work projects. 3) Give Christmas doles to all jobless by December 25.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Union demands include transparency, punitive measures for responsible authorities, immediate public employment funding and targeted relief to unemployed before holidays.

rubrics_metrics.name: Legal accountability for firms manufacturing war materials (Krupp trial charges)
rubrics_metrics.description: Prosecutors charged that the armament combine cooperated with militarists and had secretly produced war material in violation of the Versailles treaty and aided the Nazi war effort; defendants pleaded innocent to charges of manufacturing and storing war materials.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Firms may be held criminally responsible for secret rearmament and production/storage of war materials in violation of international agreements; prosecutions rest on tracing historical activities and documentary evidence.
